summary.text: Bob Fioretti is the Republican nominee for Attorney General. A Chicago attorney and former two-term alderman of the 2nd Ward (2007-2015), he has run unsuccessfully for mayor, Cook County state's attorney and Cook County Board president.

paragraphs.text: Earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Illinois and a J.D. from Northern Illinois University; practiced as a civil rights attorney.
Served as Chicago alderman for the 2nd Ward from 2007 to 2015 and, according to the Sun-Times, as an assistant Illinois attorney general.

sources.title: What to know about the race for Illinois attorney general
